T. 2. 99</ls>. .²2 Murmuring, muttering (as clouds). .{@-रः@} .²1 An indistinct or low murmur, a low, murmuring or gurgling sound. .²2 Noise in general. .²3 A door, gate. .²4 Creaking, crackling, rattling <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 The pass of a mountain. .²6 A sliding door, curtain. .²7 Mirth, laughter. .²8 An owl or a duck. .²9 A fire of chaff. .²10 A particular form of a temple; <ls>Hch. 2</ls>. .²11 The river Gogra.
